title: Vienna march against femicide and gender-based violence

tea.why: Protesters marched on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to demand an end to femicide.
tea.want: Participants demanded an end to patriarchal violence and femicide.
tea.changed: Nov 25, 2026: Hundreds marched through central Vienna starting at 18:15 and ending at Resselpark.

summary: On Wednesday evening, November 25, 2026, hundreds of people took to the streets in central Vienna for a demonstration against femicide and gender-based violence. Coinciding with the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women and the launch of the campaign '16 Days against Violence against Women', marchers chanted slogans such as 'You don't kill out of love! Stop femicides'. The protest route led through several streets including Mariahilfer Straße and Linke Wienzeile, ending at Resselpark. Organisers had registered an expected attendance of 300 to 500 participants. Authorities responded by deploying over a dozen police vehicles to temporarily block streets along the demonstration route.
response: According to source reports, over a dozen police vehicles temporarily blocked streets along the demonstration route as it progressed through the city. (Source 2)

updates.text: A demonstration against femicide and gender-based violence started at 18:15 in Vienna.
